Package app.util.cliInputFields

Class CLIIntegerField

java.lang.Object
app.util.cliInputFields.common.CLIField<Integer>
app.util.cliInputFields.CLIIntegerField
public class CLIIntegerField extends CLIField<Integer>
CLIIntegerField takes integer input from the command line interface A field is made using the builder pattern (explanation v) https://refactoring.guru/design-patterns/builder (example v) CLIIntegerField field = new CLIIntegerField.Builder(scanner, errorMessage) .defaultInput(5) (< - note: these are optional) .min(1) .max(10) .build(); (< - note: this is not optional)
